title: Noah Walked with God
text: … Noah was a righteous man, blameless in his generation; Noah walked with God.

title: Everything God Commanded
text: So Noah did everything precisely as God had commanded him.

title: Go into the Ark
text: Go into the ark, you and all your family …

title: Two by Two
text: … two by two, male and female, as God had commanded Noah.

title: The LORD Shut Him In
text: … Then the LORD shut him in.

title: Pitch Inside and Out
text: Make for yourself an ark of gopher wood; make rooms in the ark and coat it with pitch inside and out.

title: 300 Cubits Long
text: … The ark is to be 300 cubits long, 50 cubits wide, and 30 cubits high.

title: A Preacher of Righteousness
text: … preserved Noah, a preacher of righteousness, among the eight;

title: Seven Pairs
text: You are to take with you seven pairs of every kind of clean animal …

title: Shem, Ham and Japheth
text: And Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
